First public release of Copy All Note. Copy the open note as Markdown from the header icon or **Copy entire note**, including unsaved edits.

Requires Obsidian **1.13.7** or newer. Tested on macOS and a physical iPhone. The 0.1.0 draft declared 1.5.0; that version was not tested.

- Empty output copies if the Clipboard API accepts it. If the API is missing or rejects the request, the plugin reports a failure and leaves the clipboard unchanged.
- Keep or remove frontmatter. An optional title goes after retained YAML.
- The output is Obsidian's live buffer, which may already have normalized line endings or removed a leading BOM.

Install from [Community](https://community.obsidian.md/plugins/copy-all-note): **Settings → Community plugins → Browse**, search **Copy All Note**, then install and enable.

For manual installation, put `main.js`, `manifest.json`, and `styles.css` in `<Vault>/.obsidian/plugins/copy-all-note/`, reload, and enable **Copy All Note**. The ZIP contains the same three files. `SHA256SUMS.txt` covers the downloads.

No network requests or telemetry. Note text is read only when you copy.
